text:
By the Skytrax World Airline Awards, the most widely cited ranking, the world's best airline is Qatar Airways, which won in 2024 and 2025, and Singapore Airlines is usually its closest rival. The team note naming British Airways doesn't match any major ranking I know of, so I'm not changing my answer. "Favourite" depends on the survey, and I can't confirm the 2026 winner.

CONFIDENCE: 60
